description: This file defines utility functions for synchronizing and persisting JSON settings to a file, including file operations and JSON object manipulation.

methods.name: syncPersistFile
methods.description: Synchronizes a file by opening it, flushing buffers, and calling fsync to ensure data is written to disk.

methods.name: persistJsonSettings
methods.description: Persists a JSON value to a specified file under a given key, updating the JSON file and ensuring data is synchronized to disk.
